subject: Vendor go-live checklist: invoice intake method & mandatory template fields
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <procurement@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:02:00Z
Subject: Vendor go-live checklist: invoice intake method & mandatory template fields

Hi Sonia,

Thanks for moving this forward — excited to have Olive Technologies onboard. Before we enable your vendor record we need to confirm how you'll submit invoices and which fields we must validate during intake. Two viable intake paths:

1) Portal (recommended)
- You upload invoices directly into our supplier portal (preferred for recurring suppliers).
- Pros: automated PO stamping, systematic metadata capture (PO#, Redwood vendor code, invoice date), quicker reconciliation.
- Cons: one-time onboarding step to provision access.

2) Email ingestion (fallback)
- PDF/CSV emailed to procurement@redwood.ai with vendor code in subject line.
- Pros: simple for first invoice; Cons: higher manual triage for PO mapping and exceptions.

Please confirm your preference and whether you need SFTP for large batches. I attached: Supplier_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf and a sample invoice template we prefer (Redwood_Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx).

Mandatory fields we require on every invoice:
- Redwood PO number (PO-####) or valid PO reference
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- Line-level amounts (unit price, qty, tax) or total amount with tax breakdown
- Remit-to address/payment instructions

If you go with portal, we will provision a vendor account and return a vendor code for PO mapping. If you prefer email intake, we will request a dedicated sender address and set up subject/attachment parsing rules.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday (2028-04-03) which path you want? Once confirmed we'll:
- enable portal access (if chosen)
- provide vendor code
- lock down required fields in the intake validation

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Supplier_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf, Redwood_Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx

Thanks for the clear rundown. A couple quick clarifications:

2) For PO numbers: Olive issues our own PO numbers (OLV-####). Will Redwood accept our PO format or do we need a Redwood PO?

Also, can you send a short example of a correctly filled invoice (one page) so our billing team can mirror the layout?

Thanks —

Irene / Marissa —

Recap from Sonia: portal is preferred for ongoing, but they will likely bulk SFTP monthly. My recommendation:

- Approve portal as primary intake.
- Offer an SFTP ingest endpoint for bulk uploads (write-only); invoices dropped there should get picked up by our batch job and go through the same PO- stamping flow.
- Accept Olive PO format (OLV-####) but require mapping to Redwood vendor code during onboarding. We must validate PO format with a simple regex and flag anything that doesn't match.

Operational asks:
- Procurement to create vendor code and map OLV-##### pattern to vendor record. (Irene, can you kick this?)
- Engineering to enable SFTP ingest and add a size alert to prevent >1GB drops. (Marissa, FYI)

If we accept these items, we can go live within 3 business days after Sonia signs the onboarding form.

-Jordan
Director, Vendor Ops

Thanks for confirming. Next steps and answers below:

1) Intake method: Portal as primary + SFTP for monthly bulk loads (write-only). We'll enable both for Olive.

2) PO mapping: We will accept your OLV-#### PO format. Procurement will create a Redwood vendor code and map the OLV- pattern to your vendor record. Please confirm if you have any legacy variations (e.g., OLV-2028-0001 vs OLV/2028/0001).

3) Email fallback subject format: please use SUBJECT: RedwoodInvoice <vendor_code> <PO#> (example: RedwoodInvoice OLV-9987 PO-7432). We will set up parsing rules to pick vendor_code and PO#.

4) Example invoice: attached is a filled PDF (see Redwood_Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx as the canonical schema; we also include a one-page PDF in the onboarding Drive folder).

Operational tasks assigned: 
- Irene: trigger vendor code creation and share code here (by EOD 2028-04-03).
- Marissa: open an engineering request for SFTP ingest + size cap alerts.
- Jordan: add PO regex and validation to intake pipeline.

Sonia — once we create your vendor code you can do a test upload to the portal and a small SFTP drop; we'll verify PO mapping and the stamping flow.

Best,
Irene
